comment: Pre-registered pair list (PROTOCOL.md, sample section). A pair is WIRED when pairs/<id>/spec.md + rust_oracle/<id>/cases.jsonl + heldout/<id>/cases.jsonl all exist. `loop_run.py run` refuses with fewer than 10 wired pairs; authoring the remaining pairs is non-gated infrastructure (zero model cost).

pairs.spec: Euclidean remainder emod(a,b), 0 <= r < b, any sign of a
integer square root: largest r with r*r <= n
fold a list by integer division with a non-zero guard
sum of a list, reduced mod m > 0
sum of squares of a list (overflow-latent-bug class)
clamp x into [lo, hi], lo <= hi
index of x in a sorted array, -1 if absent (bounds proofs)
maximum of a non-empty list (ensures forall-bound)
sum of decimal digits of n >= 0 (div/mod recursion)
count distinct adjacent-run values in a list
